about_the_game:
• PVP Movement shooter

  • Run, dash, slide, double jump

  • Gunfight

  • Kill Confirmed

  • 3v3

  • Squad system, alternate loadout sets between matches

  • Customizable loadouts, wide variety of weapon and ability combinations

  • Anime style, cute & deadly waifus

  • Alt Y2K narrative and aesthetic

  • Deep progression

  • Unlock new abilities, weapons, skins, stickers/medals/emblems, soldier waifus

  • Management sim (mother base) unlocks in-game benefits

  • Dating Sim / Visual Novel with separate progression

  • Merge NPC Waifus

  • Local dedicated servers

Anime Movement Shooter

Sprint, slide, dash, double jump around the map with AWM (Advance Waifu Mobility) in maps designed for high-speed navigation and vertical traversal.

Time-To-Fun

Region-specific dedicated servers get you to your next match in a flash. 3v3, round-based matches with fast TTK mean you’re never more than seconds away from the action.

Deep Customization

Unlock & upgrade passive and active abilities, allowing you to mix, match, and stack for your optimal squad build. 

  • Want to go on the offensive? Equip frag grenades, damage boosters, and AOE effects for your weapons.

  • Stand your ground with health regeneration perks, bubble shields, and pulse grenades.

  • Glide through the map with stamina enhancers, double dashes, and jump pads.

PVP Meets Engaging Single Player!

Grow The Ultimate Waifu Army

Unlock & hire rare and bodacious Waifu Mercenaries to assist you in battle and build out your Mother Base.

  • Equip Merc Waifus to your squad and get perk bonuses in matches.

  • Assign MWs to combat and research facilities to grow your base power and unlock better Waifus.

  • Build additional facilities and customize your Mother Base to keep your mercenary army satisfied.

  • Collaborate with, or invade, other player’s Mother Bases to achieve world domination.

Y2K Anime Style & Narrative

Anime is hardcoded into WTF’s DNA, as you uncover a political conspiracy set to undo the world’s status quo through the Y2K virus in a visual novel style dating sim.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1600, Core i5 6600K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 560,Nvidia GeForce GTX 1050 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 2700X, Intel Core i7 4790
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 3070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Fast-TTK, 3v3 squad FPS, unlockable anime waifus, deep customization, base building, management & dating sim with Y2K aesthetic & lore.
